newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran paper says "missing" journalist in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Iran paper says "missing" journalist in Germany.

text.p: A Tehran newspaper said on Wednesday an Iranian journalist who disappeared last week had left the country and was now in Germany.

The daily Jomhuri Eslami said flight information at the state airline Iran Air showed that Faraj Sarkuhi, editor of the monthly Adineh (Friday), was issued a ticket and a boarding card and that "he definitely arrived in Hamburg airport at 1430 hours on Sunday (November 3)".
"Therefore inquiries about anything that might have happened to him should be addressed to the passport control section...in Hamburg and thereafter," the newspaper said.
It was the first time the case, which has been reported in German newspapers, was referred to in the Iranian media.
(The German Foreign Ministry said on Saturday it had asked Germany's embassy in Tehran to investigate reports Sarkuhi was detained before boarding the plane at Tehran airport.)

(Iranian opposition sources in Germany told Reuters in Bonn that Sarkuhi, who has taken part in efforts to set up an independent writers' union, was held by authorities as he was boarding the plane to visit his wife and child in Germany.)
